Average annual financial turnover not less than Rs 1.22 Lakh during preceding three years ending 31 st March, 2026 (the proof of which is to be submitted along with the tender). 20.2 The bidder should be a manufacturer or dealer/supplier with experience in preparing manufacturing d rawings and identifying the Material of Construction (MOC) through reverse engineering using 3D scanning technology. During last seven years ending last date of month prior to month of tendering. Documentary e vidence in the form of copy of PO along with Invoice/CRAC/Way Bill/Completion certificate: Three similar completed works each of value not less than Rs. 1,92,104.00 inc lusive of taxes each. OR Two similar completed works each of value not less than Rs. 2,40,130.00 inclu sive of taxes each.

OR One similar completed works of value not less than Rs. 3,84,208.00 inclusive of taxes. “Proof of supply in Government Company/Undertakings or Private Companies having Company Identificati on Number (Documentary evidence is to be attached)”. “For arriving at cost of similar work, the value of work executed shall be brought to current costing level b y enhancing the actual value of work at simple rate of 7% per annum, calculated from the date of completi on to the date of bid opening”. Note: - Bidder has to submit Work Completion Certificate along with the su bmitted Work Order. Bidder should ensure that the Work Completion Certifi cate comprise the contents preferably as per Appendix-I. 21. Scope of work 1. The Tenderer shall depute skilled & experienced Draft man to collect the drawings/sketches/ other input data for preparation of drawing work and they will prepare the required drawings in CAD. 2. The drawings shall be checked, approved and final copies shall be provided to the User Department bot h in soft & hard copies. 3.The drawings shall be related to the following disciplines: i. Mechanical engineering work including spare parts/ assembly drawings. ii. Fluid systems and Piping work. Any other as per requirement 4. Making proper sketches from spares/sub-assemblies/Assemblies/fast wearing items with the help of eith er measuring tools or scanning machine at various sites of Paste Fill plant at MCP. 5. Based on the sketches with measurement /scanned data, drawings are to be developed inCAD complete in all respects as described in technical specification. 6. Dept reserves the right to add/delete, any view/detail as deemed necessary in the drawing. 7. The party will submit final 2D drawings in hard copy, .DWG formats and 3D models to the dept. 22. Terms and conditions 1. The deployed personnel shall have experience in using 3D scanning machine for reverse engineering, C AD Software like AutoCAD, Draft sight, ZWCAD, Solid edge, Solid works, Design X, Midas etc and measurin g instruments like micrometres-inside and outside of various ranges, Vernier callipers, depth gauges, thre ad gauges, bevel protractors etc. 2. The complete responsibility for the correctness/ accuracy of the drawings and its dimensions /tolerances / fits for its manufacture/ fitting/ functioning shall be guaranteed by the contractor. For any engineering mi stakes in the drawings, up to 100% of the drawing costshall be levied as penalty and recovered from Contr actors subsequent invoices. 3. The contractor shall educate his personnel/engineers to take necessary safety precautions including use of PPE while they are at work. 4. The firm shall arrange his own transport for handling the parts and movement of his work force inside pl ant with measuring instruments /equipment at their own cost. 5. Firm may work with their own machine design software & machine. 6. The contractor shall arrange his own accommodation.

7. The scope of work shall include the preparation of Mechanical engineering drawings related to Mechanic al discipline, including new drawings, spare part drawings, assembly drawings, detail drawings, and drawin gs of wear, worn, torn, damaged, or obsolete parts. 22.1 Evaluation Method - Overall Individual L1 basis. 23 Contract Period - 10-months after placement of PO 23.1 Delivery Period - 12 Weeks after placement of PO 24 Revisions: 1.Before drawings are finally accepted by Dept, all revisions to the drawings are to be taken care by the Tenderer and no separate payment shall be made for such revisions. 2.In case major changes are made by dept which results in almost the entire drawing to be remade, the sa me shall be treated as additional drawing subject to written approval of dept’s Executing Authority in adva nce. In this regard, decision of dept shall be final and binding on the Tenderer. 3.All revisions/ corrections shall be incorporated by the contractor as a continual improvement in back up f iles. Improvement in back up files. 25 Schedule of supply of drawings: - 1. Based on sketches by measurement/ scanned data, manufacturing drawings are to be made complete i n all aspects as described in technical specification and same shall be submitted within 30 days from the d ate of completion of sketching. Sketching should be completed same day unless otherwise agreed, after s pare parts/ fast wearing items/ assemblies etc have been made available to Contractor for sketching/ scan ning. 2. Contractor will submit copy of sketches after every sketching of the parts to dept as and when required. 3. In case of emergency, the contractor has to submit fair sketch with dimensions and manufacturing deta ils immediately. 5. The contractor will submit one copy of drawing print within 15 days from the date of completion of sketc hing/scanning to PFP Executing officer for validation. 6. After validation and necessary corrections, final drawing shall be submitted in .dwg format. 26 Special Terms & Conditions: 1.The drawing shall be prepared in first angle projection. 2.The bill of material in title block shall be made in the drawing as per PFP standard. 3. Text size and proportion shall be as per IS: 9609 and geometrical tolerance as per IS:11158. 4. Drawing shall be made in accordance with various Indian Standards/ International Standards/IPSS for th e respective items. 5.Fits and tolerances shall be provided in the drawings for functional dimensions. 6. Surface finish and other machining/ functional requirements like Ovality/ Parallelism/ of parts shall featu re in the drawings. 7. Welding details shall be provided in the drawings wherever applicable.

8. Special notes if required to be added in drawings for ease in manufacturing of items/ parts. 9. Material specification with relevant Indian standard shall be given along with heat treatment, hardness details wherever required. 10. Selection of scale shall be as per IS 10713. The scale shall be chosen for a drawing will depend upon t he complexity of the object to be depicted and the purpose of the representation. Selected scale shall be l arge enough to permit easy and clear interpretation of the information depicted. Details that are too small for complete dimensioning in the main representation shall be shown adjacent to the main representation i n a separate detail view (or section) which is drawn to a large scale. 11.The contractor shall arrange relevant Indian and international standards such as IS, IPSS,DIN, JIS, Europ ean norm, GB (chinese), ASTM, Gost etc whenever required. 12. Wherever possible assembly as well as part drawing shall be made in the same drawing sheet. 13. Identify the material of construction for each spare part using suitable laboratory facilities, including: Chemical Composition Analysis Spectrometric Analysis Metallurgical Examination Hardness Testing PMI (Positive Material Identification) Heat Treatment Identification (where applicable) A detailed MOC report shall be submitted for each component. 27. Warranty/Guarantee The materials supplied shall be warranted for a period of 18 months from the date of delivery or 12 months from date of commissioning, whichever is earlier against manufacturing defe cts. 7. PERFORMANCE SECURITY (SECURITY DEPOSIT) 7.1 The successful Tenderer shall deposit an amount equivalent to 10% of the total Contract/ Work Order value including GST. 7.2 Out of this, the initial Security Deposit will amount to 5% of the total Contract/ W ork Order value including GST. The Initial Security Deposit is to be deposited by the s uccessful Tenderer within 30 (Thirty) days from the date issue of Letter of Intent/Wor k Order, whichever is earlier, in the form of Insurance Security Bond/ /NEFT/RTGS/Fix ed Deposit Receipt/Bank Guarantee (on HCL’s format) from a Scheduled Commercial Bank except Co-operative and Gramin Bank for Goods/Services/Works/EPC Contracts. In case of Bank Guarantee, it has to be as per HCL’s prescribed format. 7.3 The Security Deposit equivalent to the balance 5% of the total Contract/ Work Or der value including GST will be recovered from the progressive bills of the contractor @10% from each RA Bill. However, after every six months, 50% of the accumulated r etention money can be refunded to the contractor against submission of equivalent a mount of Bank Guarantee (BG) from scheduled commercial bank. 7.4 HCL is at liberty, after having given fourteen (14) days written notice to the contr actor, to realize and/or for unsatisfactory performance of the contract or any clauses thereof.

7.5 The above security amount shall remain fixed during the entire period of the con tract irrespective of any decrease/increase in the value of contract due to any reason like increase/decrease in labour wages, price indices, change order, etc., during the e xecution of the contract. 7.6 In case the Security Deposit is furnished by way of Bank Guarantee, it must be ini tially valid for the entire contract period plus Defect Liability Period (DLP) plus 60 day s beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations of the Contractor/contr actor, including warranty obligations. 7.7 A penal interest @18% per annum shall be collected from the bidders on a pro-ra ta basis on account of any delay towards submission of SD/ Bank Guarantee amount after the assigned period of 30 days. 7.8 Only after submission of SD, the EMD of Successful Bidder will be refunded. 7.9 Payment of Contractor will be withheld until receipt of Performance Security/ Sec urity Deposit. 7.10 The bank A/C details for RTGS/NEFT payment are as under: IFSC Code: SBIN0004510 A/C Type: Current Account A/C No.: 11290757078 A/C Name: Hindustan Copper Limited 7.11 The method of submission of Bank Guarantee is as below: The bank guarantee issued by the issuing bank on behalf of the Contractor in favour of Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) shall be in hard copy in original on stamp paper a s well as Structured Financial Messaging System (SFMS). HCL has chosen State Bank of India to act advising/beneficiary bank of HCL. The ban k issuing the guarantee on behalf of the Contractor should choose this bank to send c onfirmation through SFMS. The details of beneficiary (i.e., HCL) for issue of bank guarantee through SFMS platfor m is as furnished below: State Bank of India as Advising Bank of HCL Name and Details of BI Name Hindustan Copper Limited eneficiary II Address Tamra Bhawan 1, Ashutosh Chowdhury Avenue, Kolkata 700019 III Area Kolkata 700019 IV Name of Bank State Bank of India V Bank A/C No. 10373629348

The Guarantor (BG issuing bank) shall send information about issuance of this Guara ntee through SFMS gateway to the State Bank of India, CAG Branch Kolkata (IFSC- SB IN0009998), to aid in the process of confirmation of Bank Guarantee. “The BG shall be operable including encashment at issuing bank’s any local branch i n Malanjkhand, Madhya Pradesh.” The Original Bank Guarantee issued by the outstation bank shall be sent by the Issui ng Bank to DGM (Mktg./M&C), Hindustan Copper Limited, Malanjkhand Copper Project at Malanjkhand, Pin code- 481116 by Speed Post/Registered Post. The Company shall be at liberty to deduct and appropriate from the Security Deposit such penalties and dues as may be payable by the Contractor under the contract and the amount by which the Security Deposit shall get diminished will be made good by further deduction from the Contractor’s subsequent bills in the same manner as aforesaid until the security deposit is restored to its full limit mentioned above. it on breach of any of the terms and conditions laid down herein or will be applicable in future, without prejudice to the rights of the Company or otherwise available under the law.
